name: TypeScript
typeSystem: Static, structural, and inferred, with configurable strictness and gradual escape hatches such as any; types are erased when compiling to JavaScript and are not enforced at runtime.

typeSystemExample.caption: Generic max with a constraint on types that support comparison

runtime: Types are erased; the resulting JavaScript runs on engines such as V8, SpiderMonkey, and JavaScriptCore

runtimes.name: Transpile to JavaScript (tsc)
runtimes.role: Types are erased and TS becomes plain JS before it ever runs.

runtimes.name: Via JS engines (V8/SpiderMonkey/JSC)
runtimes.role: After transpilation, TS runs wherever JavaScript runs.

runtimes.name: Deno / Bun (direct source support)
runtimes.role: Accept .ts files and strip or transpile their types before executing JavaScript.

compilers.name: tsc
compilers.role: Reference compiler; type-checks and emits JavaScript.

compilers.name: Babel (preset-typescript)
compilers.role: Strips types as part of a Babel pipeline.

asyncRuntimes.name: Node.js
asyncRuntimes.role: libuv-based event loop; the most popular server-side platform.

asyncRuntimes.name: Deno
asyncRuntimes.role: Tokio-based event loop with native TypeScript support and permissions.

asyncRuntimes.name: Bun
asyncRuntimes.role: JavaScriptCore-based runtime with direct .ts support through type stripping or transpilation.

asyncRuntimes.name: Browser
asyncRuntimes.role: Platform event loop with Web APIs (same as JavaScript).

concurrencyModel: Inherits JS event loop: Promises, async/await, Web Workers

concurrencyExample.caption: Computing 4 squares and aggregating the results with Promise.all
